chorus.chords: C | G | F | C | Am | F | G | C
chorus.lyrics: Put them to-geth-er, add them in, / plus means more, so let's be-gin! / Count them all and you will see, / add-ing is as fun as can be!

v1.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
v1.lyrics: One red ap-ple, one more too, / one plus one, that makes two! / Count them up, one, two, / one plus one is two!

v2.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
v2.lyrics: Two lit-tle duck-lings swim-ming free, / one more joins, now that makes three! / Count them up, one, two, three, / two plus one is three!

v3.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
v3.lyrics: Two big balls and two balls more, / two plus two, that makes four! / Count them up, one, two, three, four, / two plus two is four!

v4.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
v4.lyrics: Three bright stars and two stars more, / count them up, there's five, for sure! / One, two, three, four, five, / three plus two is five!

v5.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
v5.lyrics: Five lit-tle fin-gers on this hand, / five on that one, oh how grand! / Count them all, from one to ten, / five plus five is ten!

q1.chords: C | F | G | G | C | C
q1.lyrics: What is one plus one? / Two!

q2.chords: C | F | G | G | C | C
q2.lyrics: What is two plus two? / Four!

q3.chords: C | F | G | G | C | C
q3.lyrics: What is three plus one? / Four!

q4.chords: C | F | G | G | C | C
q4.lyrics: What is four plus one? / Five!

actions.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
actions.lyrics: Clap one, clap two, then one clap more, / one, two, three, now stomp the floor! / Jump two times, then jump two more, / one, two, three, four, that makes four!

karaoke.chords: C | G | F | C | Am | F | G | C

slow.chords: C | G | C | G | C | G | C | G | C | G
slow.lyrics: Let's add them slow-ly! / One plus one / Two! / Two plus two / Four!
